title: Final d144a43 runtime trial stopped on local controller ENOSPC after two pairs

controller.failure_scope: Local controller could not persist the next worker lease observation before pair03-disabled launch. Its finally completed Oracle cleanup but could not persist its local cleanup log, preventing its Azure cleanup leg. Both hosts were then cleaned independently; no campaign restart or failed-profile retry occurred.
controller.local_disk_after_removal: 1.2 GiB available (df -h); no pre-removal df snapshot was captured, so net recovery is not asserted.
controller.receipt_provenance: Reconstructed after the controller hit ENOSPC before writing its final receipt; launch timestamp is the prior clock observation, not a process-start measurement.
